versions.name: Pottery
versions.description: Pinch, coil, and slab clay into pots, center and throw a usable vessel on the wheel, sculpt a figurine, glaze your work, and help load and fire a kiln that turns greenware into finished ceramics.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
